sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: dealer); size 483 x 254 x 44 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Dealer listings read through a search summary 2026-11-12 (the zzounds page answered 403): a front-panel 1/4 in TS DI input, XLR mic input, balanced TRS line input, balanced XLR and TRS outputs, TS insert send and return; listings disagree on whether the XLR mic input is on the front or the rear, and none names the mains connection. So beta-modelled: modelled subset only (XLR mic in, TRS line in, XLR out, TRS out on the rear, DI on the front), no mains inlet, no inserts. 1U 483 x 254 x 44 mm (dealer, w x d x h). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): the face pictures are connectors and knobs drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
